title: Retained capability acceptance contracts
normalSuiteRule: Actual native services/adapters with deterministic external/provider fixtures; no real inference including tiny/synthetic models

cases.title: Search, traversal, architecture and impact
cases.positiveAndScope: Ambiguous equal names, cycles, hubs and cross-repo edges: assert exact starting identity, bounded deterministic traversal, every consolidated operation mode and scope before expansion.
cases.failureAndRecovery: Missing/stale views never fall back to another revision or worktree.
cases.fixtureStatus: Specification only; actual native assertions not implemented/run

cases.title: Revision-bound node and source inspection
cases.positiveAndScope: Read file nodes, spans/snippets, trust and content digests across baseline, branch and local edits.
cases.failureAndRecovery: Deleted/renamed/denied source is unavailable, never silently redirected.
cases.fixtureStatus: Specification only; actual native assertions not implemented/run

cases.title: Repository catalog and metadata
cases.positiveAndScope: Assert filters, pagination, URLs, memberships, summaries, README, freshness and language coverage.
cases.failureAndRecovery: Removing an index preserves local source/history; primary source deletion needs the dedicated user action.
cases.fixtureStatus: Specification only; actual native assertions not implemented/run

cases.title: Discovery and incremental publication
cases.positiveAndScope: Exercise add/edit/delete/rename/untracked, ignore/case/size rules, missing toolchains, progress and replayed batches.
cases.failureAndRecovery: Kill staging/publication; partial or failed extraction cannot become complete/current or orphan helpers.
cases.fixtureStatus: Specification only; actual native assertions not implemented/run

cases.title: Structural and semantic coverage
cases.positiveAndScope: Golden inputs cover C/C++, C#, JS/TS/JSX/TSX, Python, Go, Java, Ruby, PHP, Bash, Rust, Swift, SQL, Terraform/HCL, Ansible/YAML and ColdFusion. Assert spans, calls/imports and domain edges; qualify .NET/TS/Swift/Rust packs separately.
cases.failureAndRecovery: Grammar loading alone is not semantic evidence. Unsupported configurations report partial/text coverage. Malicious build/restore fixtures run only inside qualified disposable boundaries.
cases.fixtureStatus: Specification only; actual native assertions not implemented/run

cases.title: Cross-repository and frontend/backend links
cases.positiveAndScope: Golden positive/negative HTTP/messaging, NuGet/npm/Cargo/Swift package identities, TS module slices, Swift type/import scope, backend registrations and Tauri bindings identify both source snapshots.
cases.failureAndRecovery: Ambiguous destinations remain unresolved/inferred; rebinding/deletion cannot retain confident stale or cross-worktree edges.
cases.fixtureStatus: Specification only; actual native assertions not implemented/run

cases.title: Branch and uncommitted views
cases.positiveAndScope: Compare every search/source/traversal/impact operation on baseline and two divergent worktrees with adds, edits, deletes and renames; request/reuse/refresh/retire.
cases.failureAndRecovery: Move the base during publication and expire a pin; reject incompatible reuse and retain explicit unavailable state.
cases.fixtureStatus: Specification only; actual native assertions not implemented/run

cases.title: Health, security, hotspots and synthesis
cases.positiveAndScope: Check deterministic metrics, secret/advisory and community fixtures. Drive project/batch/synthesis stages through real router codecs with scripted responses.
cases.failureAndRecovery: Failed synthesis preserves project results and reports partial failure; downstream docs cannot claim success. No live model/advisory service is required.
cases.fixtureStatus: Specification only; actual native assertions not implemented/run

cases.title: Unified entities, claims, evidence and lessons
cases.positiveAndScope: Assert query/search/subgraph/bundles/frontier/summary, scoped evidence, normalization, recurrence, contradiction, promote/challenge, revision and explicit deletion.
cases.failureAndRecovery: Conflicts retain evidence; no silent merge or migration of excluded legacy knowledge/memory/lessons.
cases.fixtureStatus: Specification only; actual native assertions not implemented/run

cases.title: Versioned guidance and retrieval
cases.positiveAndScope: Exercise list/read/edit/move/import/resources, applicability, revision-bound retrieval and lexical/vector publication of fresh content.
cases.failureAndRecovery: No legacy convention migration, wiki server dependency, scope leak or stale-embedding substitution.
cases.fixtureStatus: Specification only; actual native assertions not implemented/run

cases.title: Checkpointed consolidation and proposals
cases.positiveAndScope: Script no-signal skip, nonconflicting writes, contradictory evidence, proposal review, changed instructions, usage and continuation checkpoints; guarded revert.
cases.failureAndRecovery: Crash/replay cannot duplicate consolidation or erase later edits; partial/budget-exhausted runs stay distinguishable.
cases.fixtureStatus: Specification only; actual native assertions not implemented/run

cases.title: All work kinds and allocation
cases.positiveAndScope: Create/read/filter/edit/order/status/DAG/plan operations cover project, feature, issue and task; strict argument schemas, plan reconciliation and next_work races.
cases.failureAndRecovery: One live owner; cycles, stale plan approval, feature eligibility and root pauses prevent invalid dispatch.
cases.fixtureStatus: Specification only; actual native assertions not implemented/run

cases.title: Conversations, briefings and messages
cases.positiveAndScope: Check paging, native transcript order, attachments, inbox/ack/heartbeats and shared Home/sidebar identity under scripted streaming.
cases.failureAndRecovery: Cancel/restart retains acknowledged history and native tool envelopes, with no duplicate Home session or lost durable messages.
cases.fixtureStatus: Specification only; actual native assertions not implemented/run

cases.title: Lineage and evidence
cases.positiveAndScope: Follow imported/new work, plans, agents, sessions, decisions, Git/check/review links and artifacts through edits/restarts/deletion using stable cursors.
cases.failureAndRecovery: Stale results remain historical evidence and cannot complete superseding work.
cases.fixtureStatus: Specification only; actual native assertions not implemented/run

cases.title: Enforced canonical reservations
cases.positiveAndScope: Race two projects for the same physical capacity; renew/release with fences and inspect holders/waiters. Verify desktop consent separately.
cases.failureAndRecovery: Expired leases cannot transfer a live process/device; wrong owners cannot release grants.
cases.fixtureStatus: Specification only; actual native assertions not implemented/run

cases.title: Human and agent decisions
cases.positiveAndScope: Bind decisions to target/revision/authority and retain independent blockers; host-bound human receipts.
cases.failureAndRecovery: Read/dismiss is not resolution; agents cannot impersonate a user and changed proposals invalidate old receipts.
cases.fixtureStatus: Specification only; actual native assertions not implemented/run

cases.title: Versioned prompts and roles
cases.positiveAndScope: Read base/project instructions, propose/edit/reset and adopt approved versions at safe boundaries.
cases.failureAndRecovery: Unapproved agent content cannot activate or broaden reviewer/tool authority.
cases.fixtureStatus: Specification only; actual native assertions not implemented/run

cases.title: Native provider contracts
cases.positiveAndScope: Drive the router acceptance suite against actual codecs and controlled HTTP fixtures, including native tools, pins, caching, failover, usage and pricing. Include direct Max/High/Mid/Low editable pools and custom members, round-robin allocation with durable pins, independent requested/effective effort, direct named models and distinct Open Router Auto. Exercise native SystemOne model/capability discovery and structured choice/noul/score/box decisions with supported media, usage and host authority (ROUTE-18–20).
cases.failureAndRecovery: Scripted text is not live endpoint/auth/cache qualification; no real inference in the normal suite. Reject unsupported decision/effort/media capabilities before send; keep decision models outside chat tiers; no silent empty-pool cross-tier fallback or dropped explicit effort.
cases.fixtureStatus: Specification only; actual native assertions not implemented/run

cases.title: Usage and activity attribution
cases.positiveAndScope: Assert attempt/event dedupe, reporting filters, observed/estimated/free/untracked cost and cache counters per work.
cases.failureAndRecovery: No double count, missing-price false zero or retroactive repricing; subscription estimates remain labeled.
cases.fixtureStatus: Specification only; actual native assertions not implemented/run

cases.title: Schema and separately permitted data tools
cases.positiveAndScope: Cover SQLite, MariaDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL and SQL Server metadata, shared-connection/project scope, sensitive-column rules and schema-change provenance; reject the removed HelixDB reader target.
cases.failureAndRecovery: Schema indexing never stores rows; connection writes require enablement and reviewer reads cannot cause indirect mutation.
cases.fixtureStatus: Specification only; actual native assertions not implemented/run

cases.title: Outgoing MCP client and tool selection
cases.positiveAndScope: Protocol fixtures cover local/remote discovery, resources/prompts/tools, credentials, routed sampling, changed schemas and missing optional runtimes.
cases.failureAndRecovery: Outgoing annotations alone do not verify reads; excluded legacy integrations stay absent. User-added incoming MCP support has separate DW-063/064 acceptance; it is not part of these 19 frozen-source entries.
cases.fixtureStatus: Specification only; actual native assertions not implemented/run

cases.title: Observed linked issues and delivery evidence
cases.positiveAndScope: Replay typed polling/provider fixtures with durable cursors and dedupe across personal/organization repositories and exact PR heads.
cases.failureAndRecovery: No inbound webhook server dependency, sync loop or stale-check acceptance.
cases.fixtureStatus: Specification only; actual native assertions not implemented/run

cases.title: Repository/project review and delivery
cases.positiveAndScope: Inspect findings/severity/source heads and transcripts; external/in-app review, response/fix/adjudication and exact-head readiness.
cases.failureAndRecovery: Every actionable finding is resolved; disputed/unavailable reviews do not become success, and all required repository heads must be ready before merge.
cases.fixtureStatus: Specification only; actual native assertions not implemented/run

cases.title: Manual and scheduled jobs
cases.positiveAndScope: Create/edit/enable/disable/delete/run_now with saved timezone/scope/history; test skip-overlap, missed occurrences and recovery classes. Report per-run observed/estimated/free/untracked usage without job spending limits under JOB-09; dispatched feature-owned work retains feature-budget admission and no double charge.
cases.failureAndRecovery: No catch-up storm, implicit feature Continue or autoactivation of restored schedules/keep-working. No job-cap hold or budget bypass by relabeling feature requests as job work.
cases.fixtureStatus: Specification only; actual native assertions not implemented/run

cases.title: Local durable event delivery
cases.positiveAndScope: Atomic state/event/delivery, lost wakeup, bounded saturation, fan-out, ordered partitions, poison failure and duplicate ack against the actual runtime/store.
cases.failureAndRecovery: Lost external result requires reconciliation; stale leases or resolved delivery failure never grant Continue.
cases.fixtureStatus: Specification only; actual native assertions not implemented/run

cases.title: Capability Help and repository docs
cases.positiveAndScope: Generate version-matched Help from the registry while preserving authored sections. Separately generate repository docs from exact index/analysis evidence through normal Git work/review.
cases.failureAndRecovery: Partial analysis is labeled; generation cannot overwrite unrelated edits or bypass delivery gates.
cases.fixtureStatus: Specification only; actual native assertions not implemented/run

cases.title: Selected existing CodeGraph work/history
cases.positiveAndScope: Consistent export includes projects/features/tasks, memberships/statuses/plans/dependencies, agents/sessions/transcripts/decisions/Git/review/evidence and attachments. Preview counts/ID maps and resume without duplicates.
cases.failureAndRecovery: Exclude derived indexes and legacy memory/knowledge/lessons/conventions. Historical Shortcut links stay inert; no live Shortcut/Kanban importer or autoexecution.
cases.fixtureStatus: Specification only; actual native assertions not implemented/run

cases.title: Controlled bookkeeping retention
cases.positiveAndScope: Preview eligible diagnostics/run/session records with active pins/references and durable checkpoints; destructive pruning needs explicit selection.
cases.failureAndRecovery: Do not copy legacy destructive default schedules or erase required history/artifacts/unresolved effects for disk pressure.
cases.fixtureStatus: Specification only; actual native assertions not implemented/run

cases.title: Local errors, logs and health
cases.positiveAndScope: Inspect scoped operation/process/storage/queue health with bounded reviewed export and source/run links.
cases.failureAndRecovery: Scrub known credentials before ordinary persistence/export; optional failures cannot prevent offline browsing.
cases.fixtureStatus: Specification only; actual native assertions not implemented/run

cases.title: Native workspaces
cases.positiveAndScope: Visit repository/node/schema/graph/cluster/impact and Home/feature/issue views through shared operation IDs and versioned Help, preserving selections/drafts.
cases.failureAndRecovery: Navigation cannot grant authority, duplicate conversations or expose another project.
cases.fixtureStatus: Specification only; actual native assertions not implemented/run

cases.title: Typed scoped settings
cases.positiveAndScope: Exercise inherited values, expected revisions, validation, source explanations and saved schema/Help versions.
cases.failureAndRecovery: Repository text cannot broaden authority; revocation wins over cached forms.
cases.fixtureStatus: Specification only; actual native assertions not implemented/run

cases.title: Native single-user replacement
cases.positiveAndScope: Native diagnostics and local permissions replace legacy server readiness, service login and administrator membership. Optional incoming MCP uses explicit per-client registration through the application gateway, with separate DW-063/064 acceptance.
cases.failureAndRecovery: No mandatory app server/background daemon, service HMAC login or OS user switching; offline core use succeeds. The optional desktop-owned MCP listener/bridge is an explicit baseline 1.1 addition, not a restored legacy server deployment.
cases.fixtureStatus: Specification only; actual native assertions not implemented/run

cases.title: Explicit source exclusions
cases.positiveAndScope: Assert no bundled Shortcut/RabbitMQ tools/configuration/jobs or selected legacy-memory import; retain source inventory disposition and decision provenance.
cases.failureAndRecovery: Never count excluded rows as parity or remove their historical references from imported work.
cases.fixtureStatus: Specification only; actual native assertions not implemented/run

mcpServerAmendment.acceptance: Two independent clients, both transports/protocol profiles; complete code/work/Knowledge query projection, scope/citation parity, default-denied and granted commands, authenticated revocation/publication and durable retry/close/restore recovery. New scope is not falsely counted as frozen-source server parity.
